## mE — the round-13 strict-frame law reverted to accept-any-non-null-result

Spec (added to the `admin_trace_test.go` header BEFORE the round-13
implementation): the strict walk gutted back to the pre-round-13 lenient
shape — frame type unchecked, `to` via `common.FromHex` with malformed
treated as non-targeting, `input` via `common.FromHex` with hex errors
silently discarded, absent-input checked only on proxy-targeting frames — so
a degraded RPC answer (result:{}, a mangled proxy `to`, an undecodable
